critical_code_review_comments: Sparkline implementation is correct: _bucketed_counts builds N equal time-slices across [start,end) and the last bucket closes at end — no off-by-one gap; values are counts (ints) which the test asserts.

Decimal128 fix is done via a central _campaign_public() helper that walks k:v and converts Decimal128 → float via to_aud — same pattern as _expense_public. Future money fields on the campaign doc will be auto-handled.

/briefing/latest idempotency key = daily:<Sydney date> OR weekly:<ISO-year-week> with a unique index on bos_briefings.key + upsert — correct and timezone-aware; repeat calls read the stored doc first and return the same stored_at.
pct_change honestly returns None when previous=0 — verified across all metrics; UI renders N/A (never a misleading %).

/trends does not auto-send/publish anything; /briefing/latest only generates+stores a fact-separated briefing (recommendations are advisory text, not executions). Approval != execution gating preserved.
help_articles public list stays at 15 published — untouched.

The ZZTEST cleanup in this iteration also removed one stale ZZTEST campaign left over from iter400 (ZZTEST campaign 1562e634) — recommend making iter400's teardown hard-fail if any created id is still in Mongo at exit, so the next regression can trust the baseline.
